STATE LEVEL POLICE RECRUITMENT BOARD, ASSAM
ADVERTISEMENT
Advertisement for 181 posts of Grade IV staff in Assam Police,
6 posts of Grade IV staff in Assam Commando Battalions and
69 posts of Grade IV staff under DGCD & CGHG.
Online Applications will be received with effect from 22-01-2026 to 22-02-2026.

5. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
5.5 Age:
5.5.1 For the posts of Assam Commando Battalions : The age of the Applicant must be 18-25 years as on 01-01-2026.
5.5.2 For the posts of Assam Police, F & ES and DGCD & CGHG : The age of the Applicant must be 18-40 years as on 01-01-2026.
5.5.A Relaxations : Upper age limit for different categories are as under:
1 SC, ST (P) and ST (H) 5 years
2 OBC/MOBC 3 years
5.6 EDUCATIONAL AND OTHER QUALIFICATION REQUIRED:
5.6.1 Multitasking & Maintenance Staff- II (Non-Technical)
Minimum Class VIII passed from a recognized School or Institution and maximum qualification will be
HSSLC or Class XII passed from recognized Board or Council.
5.6.1.A Other Certificate required:
Cook :-
Training Certificate issued by Sector Skill Council (SSC) will carry 5 marks. or
Minimum 01 (one) year working experience Certificate from a recognized/registered Cooking
Institution or Hotel will carry 5 marks.
Barber :-
Training Certificate issued by Sector Skill Council (SSC) will carry 5 marks. or
Minimum 01 (one) year experience Certificate from registered Saloon/Beauty Parlour will carry 5 marks.
Water Carrier :-
Training Certificate issued by Sector Skill Council (SSC) will carry 5 marks.
Dhobi :-
Training Certificate issued by Sector Skill Council (SSC) will carry 5 marks. or
Minimum 01 (one) year experience Certificate from a registered Laundry/Dry Cleaner will carry 5 marks.
Cobbler :-
Training Certificate issued by Sector Skill Council (SSC) will carry 5 marks. or
Two years experience in leather work from Central/State Government Institution.
5.6.2 Multitasking & Maintenance Staff- I (Technical)
Minimum Class VIII passed from a recognized School or Institution and maximum qualification
will be HSSLC or Class XII passed from recognized Board or Council.
5.6.2.A Other Certificate required:
Plumber :-
Minimum one year Certificate course from a recognized Industrial Training Institution/Vocational Institute will carry 5 marks.
5.7 PHYSICAL STANDARDS:
5.7.1 Height:
5.7.2 Chest (Only for men):
5.7.3 Weight: Proportionate to height and age as per Medical Standards.
5.8 MEDICAL STANDARDS:
Applicant must be in good mental and bodily health and should not be colour blind or squint eyed.
Eye Sight: distance vision should be 6/6 for at least one eye and not poorer than 6/9 for the other.
6. HOW TO APPLY:
6.1 Instructions for Registration and Application Submission
(i) Applicants must register in the application portal only once.
(ii) Applicants must enter personal and qualification details accurately.
Sl. No. Categories Male Female
(a) General/OBC/MOBC/SC 160 cm 150 cm
(b) ST (P)/ST (H) 158 cm 147.5 cm
Sl. No. Categories Normal Expansion
(a) General/OBC/MOBC/SC/
ST (P)
Min. 80 cm + 5 cm
(b) ST (H) Min. 77 cm + 5 cm
(iii) Upload necessary documents and submit the application.
6.2 DOCUMENTS
(i) Latest passport size photograph.
(ii) Class VIII Passed Certificate.
(iii) Trade training or experience Certificate as applicable.
7. PHASES OF RECRUITMENT TESTS:
i) Medical Examination followed by Physical Standard Test (PST).
ii) Trade Proficiency Test (TPT).
7.1 PRELIMINARY IDENTITY VERIFICATION: Admit Card and Identity Proof will be checked.
7.2 BIOMETRIC: Biometric may be conducted again when necessary.
7.3 MEDICAL EXAMINATION: Applicants will be examined as per the medical parameters.
7.4 PHYSICAL STANDARD TEST (PST): It will carry no marks.
7.5 TRADE PROFICIENCY TEST: 50 Marks
7.6 INSTRUCTIONS FOR PST AND PROFICIENCY TEST IN TRADE
i. An Applicant is eliminated when failing to qualify in a test.
ii. A Rejection Slip will be issued.
iii. CCTV will record each event.
8. FINAL MERIT LISTS:
Maximum Marks: 50
Passed Marks: 33%
The final merit lists will be prepared from Trade Proficiency Test marks.
